pull.title: KAFKA-20803: Demultiplex batched persister responses once ( Index batched delete handler)
pull.body:
Follow-up to #22835 for [KAFKA-20803](https://issues.apache.org/jira/browse/KAFKA-20803).

- **What:** Remove repeated scans of batched `DELETE_SHARE_GROUP_STATE` responses.
- **How:** Build one shared `PartitionResultIndex` per batch and look up each handler's result by topic ID and partition.
- **Impact:** Reduce demultiplexing from O(N²) to average O(N), using O(N) temporary indexing memory while preserving errors and retries.
